description: Zones de compétence en Alimentation en Eau Potable is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Areas of competence in Drinking Water Supply (AEP) of Public Establishments for Intercommunal Cooperation (EPCI). An EPCI, whatever its form, may have powers as an AEP conferred by its statutes (Article L5211-5 of the CGCT: General Code of communities Territorial). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Areas of Competence in Drinking Water Supply" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes. The listing shows 2018-10-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
